name: Dance With the Pines
source:
Dance With the Pines follows a buck named Russell and a backpacking trip through the continent of Europe with a group from college. Russell encounters many opportunities to meet people, rekindle old romance, or even find a special someone.

[From [url=https://neonkangaroo.itch.io/dance-with-the-pines]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Dance With the Pines》讲述一只名叫Russell的雄鹿，以及他和一群大学同伴结伴背包游历欧洲大陆的旅程。Russell一路上有许多机会结识新朋友、重燃旧日恋情，甚至邂逅命中注定的另一半。

[引自[url=https://neonkangaroo.itch.io/dance-with-the-pines]Itch.io[/url]]
